messages:
maria: Hey support — customer in prod is getting 400s from POST /v1/rerank after upgrading our mobile SDK. They report '400 Bad Request' with no helpful payload.
jordan: Can you paste the exact request body and the server response (body + status)?
maria: Sure — here's what customer sent (redacted ids):\n```json\n{\n  \"items\": \"\",\n  \"queries\": [{\"id\": \"q-123\", \"text\": \"Which product is best?\"}],\n  \"top_k\": [3],\n  \"metadata\": {\"platform\": \"iOS\"}\n}\n```\nResponse: `HTTP/1.1 400 Bad Request`\n```json\n{\"error\": \"request validation failed: items must be an array of candidate objects\"}\n```
sam: Interesting — two obvious problems: items is an empty string (should be []), and top_k is an array instead of an integer. SDK should serialize empty arrays as [] not "". top_k should be a number. Might be an SDK breaking change in iOS serialization.
lee: Customer is on mobile SDK v2.3.1 behind a corporate proxy that sometimes rewrites Content-Type to text/plain. That + NSJSONSerialization oddities could cause the server to parse differently. Also saw a variant where the SDK wrapped payload under `payload` top-level key when network adaptor was configured.
support-bot: Ticket created: CS-9221 — severity:P2 — assigned to eng-api.
jordan: Can you repro locally with curl using the exact body? Post the curl you used.
maria: Repro curl I ran (using the same bytes the customer sent):\n```bash\ncurl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/rerank \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer REDACTED\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -d '{"items":"","queries":[{"id":"q-123","text":"Which product is best?"}],"top_k":[3]}'\n```\nResult: HTTP/1.1 400 and body same as customer. So server rejects this shape reproducibly.
sam: I ran a quick local run: if I change items to [] and top_k to 3 I get 200/OK. Server log snippet: `validation.go:87 validateItems: items type string -> reject`
Stack: validateRequest -> parseJSON -> validateItems
lee: Short term advice to CS: ask customer to patch request before sending: ensure items is [] when empty and send top_k as integer. Also force Content-Type: application/json on the request.
Longer term: I recommend eng-api improve validation error to say expected array vs got string and include a pointer to SDK upgrade doc. Assigning to @eng-api for an API-side better error + SDK hotfix.
jordan: Agreed. I've added notes in CS-9221 with repro steps and curl. Eng-api, can you add a clearer validator error message (e.g., `items must be an array; got string`) and check whether we can log a normalized request sample to help customers?
eng-api: ACKed. Will triage, looking at validator locations. Tentative fix: return field path + expected type in 2xx of CS-9230. Also will contact mobile SDK team about serialization edge-case.
maria: Thanks — forwarding workaround to customer. Will update ticket when they confirm.
